decisions.reason: Restricting the dealer-login button to the top right does not change the founder image or its bottom-of-page placement.
The button-placement decision belongs to the separate dealer-login action; the landing-page content composition remains unchanged, and its existing layout verification needs no value edit.
The source changes the functional dealer-login button placement, not the hero visualization or the buttons depicted within that visual.
The dealer-login placement restriction does not alter the approved visual aesthetic, brand-asset usage, or style reference.
The dealer-login button placement does not change the hero headline; the possible addition of copy is not a concrete copy modification.
Button placement has no effect on the Webflow hosting-plan selection rule.
The site ownership handoff remains unchanged by the dealer-login button placement decision.
Restricting the dealer-login button location does not change contact-form submission delivery or recipient emails.
